task: Help me turn these notes into a clear statement of facts for the claim, in date order.
text:
Notes for my small-claims form (deadline 30 November):

- Decorator: Bram Okafor. Agreed price was 650 pounds for the hallway and stairs. I first wrote 600 in my email to him, but that was a typo; the signed quote says 650.
- I paid a 200-pound deposit on 1 August, not the full amount. Nothing else has been paid.
- Bram left after two days. The stairs were never painted, and the hallway needs a second coat.
- My husband, Jarek, spoke to Bram on 9 August. Bram told Jarek he would come back "within a fortnight". He didn't.
- My neighbour, Ama Mensah-Lindqvist, saw the unfinished work and might give a written statement, but only if it doesn't go to a hearing.
- Bram later offered to refund 100 pounds if I dropped the claim. I did not accept.
- I'm claiming the 200-pound deposit back plus 85 pounds for paint I bought myself.
